Yes, that's exactly the behavior I wanted to be sure of. Searching "old typography" in All bookmarks and then archiving it made it vanish from those everyday results — it didn't keep hovering in my normal searches — and when I went and searched inside the Archive, there it was, found on purpose. So archived things genuinely stay out of my way until I deliberately go looking for them in the Archive, and searching respects whichever place I'm standing in.

That settles my one lingering worry from before. The whole set-aside behavior — tucking things away, giving them a safe home, restoring them, and keeping them out of the everyday until I choose otherwise — matches what I wanted.
